result.rationale: The diff defines minimumTokenResponseSchema with computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts. `z.string()` is a ZodString object; `.toString()` yields "[object Object]", so those keys are useless literals. The schema then only validates access_token, and since z.object strips unknown keys by default, the parsed data would drop expiry/refresh_token/instance_url — the function even sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (a literal string), showing refresh_token isn't preserved. Real correctness defect introduced by this diff.
